topics.label: Lecture introduction and framing of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic serves as the lecture opening, introducing the subject's importance and outlining the lecture structure.

topics.label: Foundations, nomenclature, and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce the core architecture, naming conventions, and central role of complement component C3 in driving the cascade.

topics.label: Pathways of complement activation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct upstream recognition pathways that trigger complement activation and converge on C3 convertase formation.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the downstream effector mechanisms through which activated complement eliminates pathogens and stimulates inflammation.

topics.label: Host regulation of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the molecular mechanisms and regulatory proteins that prevent complement from attacking healthy host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic examines the distinct medical pathologies and infection susceptibilities associated with deficiencies in specific complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details how bacterial pathogens employ diverse molecular strategies to evade complement-mediated destruction.

topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic serves as the lecture closing, concluding the discussion of complement and previewing the upcoming topic.
